---
title: "ocel env unpublish"
description: "Remove the values one infrastructure program wrote, at the versions it wrote, read as JSON on stdin."
---

```bash
ocel env unpublish [flags]
```

The input is a provider.variablestore.v1.PublishedVersions in protobuf JSON, each key with the version `ocel env publish --json` reported writing:

```bash
{"values": [{"key": "API_KEY", "version": "3"}]}
```

A value the publisher has written again since is left in place, so a program that moved the call publishing it keeps the values the new call wrote when the old one is removed.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--environment` | `string` |  | Use this named preview environment; requires `--preview` |
| `--preview` | `bool` | `false` | Use preview values |
| `--publisher` | `string` |  | The stable id of the program that published these values |

Every command also takes the [global flags](/docs/cli#global-flags).

## Behaviour

- Changes state.
- Prints data on stdout. Under `--json` it prints one result envelope, whose JSON Schema `ocel schema env unpublish` prints.
